subtitle: Outdoor activity rain-conflict planning with human approval
description: Unpublished local Stage 1 build. Save one outdoor activity in Ripple. The host-selected Agent reads the activity and live weather, searches dry candidates, and proposes a change. Explicit approval and independent persisted read-back are required. Activity title, times and location are shared with the selected Provider after host consent. Coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo. No external calendar access or sync.
release_notes: Unpublished Stage 1 validation. User-owned Ripple activity; real Agent read/search; approval and independent storage verification.
